Mobile Food Vending Service Adopted: August 1, 2016

7.7___ Mobile Food Vending Service Mobile Food Vending Services may be permitted only in Traditional Highway Commercial zoning districts, provided that all of the following criteria are met:

77-1 The Mobile Food Vending Service must be located entirely on private property and shall not be located in any required setback, buffer, public right-of-way, designated open space, designated off-street parking area or designated off-street loading and unloading spaces.

7.7-2 Any operator of a Mobile Food Vending Service must receive and display a signed writing from the Town's Clerk verifying compliance with zoning, and issue of a valid occupational license and a one-year Mobile Food Vending Service permit.

7.7-3 The maximum duration of a Mobile Food Vending Service permit is one year at one location. The Council may establish an annual fee for such permit.

7.7-4 The operator of a Mobile Food Vending Service shall obtain, in writing, the permission of the property owner to operate upon his property and shall submit a copy to the Town’s Clerk.

7.7-5 Trash receptacles shall be provided for customers to dispose of food wrappers, food utensils, paper products, cans, bottles, food, and other such waste, Such receptacle shall be located not more than 10 feet from the mobile food vendor.

7.7-6 The hours of operation shall only be between AM and PM.

7.7-7 The Mobile Food Vending Service shall not locate in any minimum required parking spaces for other businesses on the site. Parking spaces may be shared with other uses on the site, unless the Town’s Clerk determines that parking congestion problems will be present on the site. The Town’s Clerk may require additional parking to alleviate the congestion. If enough parking cannot be provided, the use may not be located on the site.

7.7-8 The mobile food vendor must meet all applicable Town ordinances, applicable State permitting and regulations, and State and County health codes.

7.7-9 Operator must have a valid Town occupational license, unless exempt.

7,7-10 The operator’s business use must be a use that is otherwise allowed within the zoning district in which the operator proposes to operate.

77-11 Any power sources must meet all applicable electrical code standards. 7.7-12 Amplified sound or sound equipment is prohibited. 7,7-13 Any and all signable must comply with the Town’s Sign Ordinance.

7.7-14 Maximum of one Mobile Food Vending Service per Town approved lot.

Mobile Food Vending Service Adopted:

7.7-15 Operators conducting business from a mobile food unit on private property shall not be permitted to operate in the following areas:

- a. Within 15 feet of any street intersection or pedestrian crosswalk.

- b. Within 10 feet of any driveway.

- c. Within 50 feet of another vending location assigned by the Town to another vendor.

- d. Any area within 15 feet of a building exit.

- e. Within 200 feet of a stationary business selling the same or similar products.
